Rice noodles, peanut sauce (999mL of flavor).

1. Remove and discard oxygen absorber.
2. Remove peanut butter and peanut packet. Add peanut butter into pouch.
3. Add 1 3⁄4 cups (420mL) of boiling water.
4. Stir well, seal pouch, wait 8 minutes.
5. Stir again, reseal, wait 7 more minutes.
6. Sprinkle peanuts over meal. Enjoy!

Rehydration time doubles every 5,000 feet of elevation gain. Our directions are set for 5,000 feet.

Best By Date on packaging is 3 years from manufacturing date.
